findings.evidence: `rg --files code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups | sort` shows both `code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator.lean` and `code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/GeneratorInvariance.lean`; line 7 imports `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator`, confirming the new file is an extension of the existing generator API.
findings.fix: Mechanically move `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator.lean` to `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator/Basic.lean`, move this file to `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator/Invariance.lean`, and update imports accordingly.
findings.issue: Adding `GeneratorInvariance.lean` as a flat sibling of the existing `Generator.lean` leaves two `Generator*` files in one directory instead of grouping the shared leading CamelCase component.

summary: The new semigroup generator material is topically placed, but the file layout violates the prefix-sharing directory rule for `Generator*.lean` files.
